metadata.title: Hand Slide Controller Optimization Decision Matrix
metadata.audit_policy: Strict evidence partitioning. All synthetic and unmeasured theoretical estimates are purged. Only candidates with raw empirical measurement files contain numeric benchmark data.

candidates.name: Production v1 Baseline (LIVE_STREAM_WORKER, Normal Priority, Sequential set())
candidates.latency_gain: 0.40 ms Callback->Gesture (eliminated 16 ms main loop gap)
candidates.hardware_dependency: Standard Windows PC with CPU and Webcam

candidates.name: Production v2 (LIVE_STREAM_WORKER, ABOVE_NORMAL Priority, Constructor Params)
candidates.performance_gain: Significant: 29.02 FPS throughput (+29.3% vs v1), 0 dropped frames
candidates.latency_gain: Capture->Action dropped from 68.59 ms to 24.54 ms mean (-64.2%)
candidates.cpu_reduction: Neutral (~80% CPU load on 2 hands simultaneous)
candidates.startup_impact: +1.76s faster warm startup (7.91s vs 9.67s, -18.2%) via direct ctor params
candidates.implementation_complexity: Low (Direct constructor params with fallback + psutil priority)
candidates.packaging_complexity: Very Low (9.16 MB standalone EXE, no new binary dependencies)
candidates.maintenance_risk: Very Low (Standard OpenCV MSMF + Win32 process priority)
candidates.hardware_dependency: Standard Windows PC with CPU and Webcam

candidates.name: CPU Tuning: ABOVE_NORMAL Process Priority (Isolated A/B Test)
candidates.performance_gain: +4.5 ms mean Capture->Action improvement; P95 tail jitter reduced by 6.2 ms
candidates.latency_gain: Lower tail jitter under Windows background tasks
candidates.implementation_complexity: Trivial (1-line psutil call on startup with safe fallback)

candidates.name: Confidence Tuning: det=0.50 (High Detection Confidence)
candidates.performance_gain: Fast inference (52.6 ms mean), +2.3 Hz result rate
candidates.accuracy_impact: CRITICAL REGRESSION: Missed Segment 3 SCISSORS action completely
candidates.maintenance_risk: High (Strict confidence misses initial gesture entries)

candidates.name: Camera Startup: Candidate D (Constructor Parameters cv2.CAP_MSMF)
candidates.performance_gain: Camera-level measurement: cuts hardware negotiation time by 2.18s
candidates.latency_gain: Neutral on inference; camera delivers stable 28.97 FPS at 1280x720
candidates.startup_impact: Startup improved from 9.92s to 7.74s mean across 5 camera trials
candidates.implementation_complexity: Low (Direct constructor parameter list with safe fallback)

candidates.name: Camera Startup: Candidate E (DirectShow Backend cv2.CAP_DSHOW)
candidates.performance_gain: Negative: Camera effective frame rate collapsed to 11.23 FPS
candidates.latency_gain: Negative (Frame interval 89 ms vs 34 ms MSMF due to YUY2 USB 2.0 limitation)
candidates.accuracy_impact: Severe (11 FPS causes missed fast gestures)
candidates.startup_impact: Startup time 10.22s (slower than MSMF constructor params)
candidates.maintenance_risk: High (DirectShow is a legacy deprecated API on Windows 11)

candidates.name: Camera Startup: Candidate B (Read-First MSMF Resolution Switch)
candidates.performance_gain: Fatal failure: Triggers OpenCV matrix stride assertion crash
candidates.startup_impact: Crashes on second cap.read() (_step >= minstep failure)
candidates.verdict: REJECT (FATAL CRASH IN OPENCV MSMF STRIDE)

candidates.name: MediaPipe Tasks GPU Delegate (Windows Native)
candidates.implementation_complexity: Impossible without rebuilding MediaPipe C++ Bazel graph from source with ANGLE
candidates.verdict: NOT FEASIBLE (DISABLED IN GOOGLE BUILD FLAGS: 'ImageCloneCalculator: GPU processing is disabled in build flags')

candidates.name: LiteRT Windows GPU Delegate
candidates.implementation_complexity: Very High (No prebuilt GPU Python wheels for Windows exist)
candidates.verdict: NOT FEASIBLE (NO OFFICIAL WINDOWS GPU WHEEL AVAILABLE)

candidates.name: ONNX Runtime CUDA (Custom Pipeline Architecture)
candidates.accuracy_impact: THEORETICAL ESTIMATE / NOT BENCHMARKED (High risk: coordinate drift on custom affine decode)
candidates.startup_impact: THEORETICAL ESTIMATE / NOT BENCHMARKED (CUDA context initialization overhead)
candidates.implementation_complexity: Extreme (Must reimplement Palm decode, NMS, Affine crop, 3D projection)
candidates.packaging_complexity: Extreme (Severe packaging bloat: requires bundling full CUDA/cuDNN DLL runtimes)
candidates.maintenance_risk: Extreme (Custom CV ops replace Google graph)
candidates.verdict: THEORETICAL ESTIMATE / NOT BENCHMARKED (NEGATIVE ROI & PACKAGING BLOAT)

candidates.name: ONNX Runtime DirectML (Custom Pipeline Architecture)
candidates.startup_impact: THEORETICAL ESTIMATE / NOT BENCHMARKED (Direct3D12 device creation penalty)
candidates.implementation_complexity: Extreme (Same custom CV pipeline reimplementation as CUDA)
candidates.verdict: THEORETICAL ESTIMATE / NOT BENCHMARKED (HIGH COMPLEXITY FOR UNPROVEN GAIN)

candidates.name: WSL2 Ubuntu MediaPipe GPU via IPC
candidates.latency_gain: THEORETICAL ESTIMATE / NOT BENCHMARKED (Cross-OS Hyper-V socket/shared-memory IPC round-trip overhead)
candidates.startup_impact: THEORETICAL ESTIMATE / NOT BENCHMARKED (Requires starting WSL2 VM)
candidates.packaging_complexity: Impossible (Requires WSL2 and Linux distro on user machine)
candidates.hardware_dependency: Windows 11 with WSL2 + NVIDIA WSL driver
candidates.verdict: THEORETICAL ESTIMATE / NOT BENCHMARKED (HIGH IPC OVERHEAD & NON-PORTABLE)
